description: This file defines the CacheContextsManager class in Drupal, responsible for managing cache context services, converting cache context tokens into cache keys, optimizing tokens, and validating cache context tokens within Drupal's caching system.

classes.name: CacheContextsManager
classes.description: Manages cache context services, converts tokens to cache keys, optimizes tokens, and validates cache context tokens for Drupal's caching system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all available cache context IDs.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns labels for cache contexts, optionally including calculated cache contexts.

methods.name: convertTokensToKeys
methods.description: Converts cache context tokens into cache keys and cacheability metadata.

methods.name: optimizeTokens
methods.description: Reduces cache context tokens to a minimal representative subset.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a cache context service from the container by context ID.

methods.name: parseTokens
methods.description: Parses cache context tokens into context IDs and optional parameters.

methods.name: validateTokens
methods.description: Validates an array of cache context tokens, throwing exceptions for invalid tokens.

methods.name: assertValidTokens
methods.description: Checks if cache context tokens are valid, returning boolean.
